findings.text: The code only checks if obj1 can convert to time.Time but not obj2; when comparing time.Time with a non-convertible struct, line 42's obj2Value.Convert(timeType) will panic.

The type assertion for obj2 at line 40 can fail, and the fallback Convert at line 42 has no guard—if obj2 is a struct that cannot convert to time.Time, it panics instead of returning compareEqual, false.

0.reason: The panic from converting obj2 is a symptom of the same time comparison code path, but the root cause is the UnixNano() overflow in the time comparison, so this is the reference bug.

1.reason: The unguarded Convert for obj2 is part of the same time comparison block, and the underlying defect is the UnixNano() overflow, so this is the reference bug.
